I understand but being a southerner and understanding the relationship of the "Planter or Master" class vs The Regular Person I cannot imagine a world where this will not he used to annex out a white blue collar dominated voter base too if needed.


Long Beach Mike (@longbeachmike73)

That doesn't make any sense Mike.  I appreciate feeling like this is a big screw job by the GOP, but it's not.  The left has been drawing maps around black communities and siloing the votes.  You don't work for the

Beyond Race this is going to become Class.  U will see worker class districts chopped to disproportionately favor those that are "above" them and the interests of corporations vs the people


Long Beach Mike (@longbeachmike73)

No amount of complaining is going to change the fact you can’t draw lines based on race.  Not one persons right to vote is restricted.
